headline: Beta Drugs files AGM scrutinizer report and voting results
hook: AGM voting results submitted to exchanges
summary: Beta Drugs Limited has submitted the scrutinizer's report and voting results for its Annual General Meeting held on September 30, 2026, to the stock exchange. The routine filing completes the post-AGM compliance process for the company. Retail shareholders can review the outcome of resolutions passed during the meeting on the exchange portal. This is standard corporate governance procedure with no direct impact on stock valuation.
why_it_matters: Routine compliance filing with no impact on share price
